earned.grid: The root header/status, compass, navigator cells and site-host composition are projected from realized recursive addresses; default addresses turn without selecting the old upright spans. The original Back/compass swap remains bound to its exchanged cells.
earned.type: At rank zero U=max(viewport width,viewport height)/64, the long side of address wwwwww. Rank r is U*2^(r/2); U=13.1875 CSS px when the long side is 844 CSS px. The DOM and the shared Canvas/Pretext type API use that origin.
earned.browser: The common-field step of https://github.com/QuantumCephalopod/cambium/actions/runs/42737368577 passed 20 Canvas2D cases (all six sites at 1280x800, 390x844 and 320x568, plus two Philosophy formats) and two software-WebGL Philosophy cases; the separate long-axis step passed 12 site/orientation cases and live resize. It also checked the stated cell rectangles and trial actions, not complete experience.
earned.ci: https://github.com/QuantumCephalopod/cambium/actions/runs/42737800790 passed build, tree-addressed source/owner checks, address algebra, closure and public-byte checks; its browser steps were skipped.

counterexamples_and_limits: The full mobile witness at https://github.com/QuantumCephalopod/cambium/actions/runs/42737368564 failed: at 320x568 the touch at the map corner targeted the neighbouring help button. A diagnostic at https://github.com/QuantumCephalopod/cambium/actions/runs/42738009761 observed elementFromPoint on the canvas while the delivered touch was captured by mini-help-toggle. A pointer-cursor experiment and a separate click-listener experiment both reproduced the failure; neither is counted as a fix.
The local software-GLES sharp-ink witness failed its solid-glyph equality check after type and shadow began scaling with the viewport. This remains a real open graphics witness, not a pass.

Papers still uses local reading-region and text-fit calculations; some local styles and the independent static-document type origin are not fully grid-bound. The mobile screenshot shows that bounded content can require scrolling and is not itself proof of comfortable reading.

Continued browser-diagnostic steps in the cited draft run report their own failures even when the enclosing run concludes success; no complete mobile, selected-Source, physical-device, deployment or user acceptance claim is made.
next: Resolve the actual map-touch hit target and re-run the full mobile contact suite; then migrate the remaining independently sized screen/reading/static carriers and resolve sharp-ink parity. Keep source-faithful intake and the child-return UPLINK in the stomach until their exit conditions are actually met.
